properties.description:
A `GOVERNED_BY` edge carrying `ruling: parks` records that a node's UNATTACHED or UNSATISFIED state is correct and deliberate. `orphan_node` and `unsatisfied_requirement` skip it; `detect_defects` reports it in `swept.parked`. `governed_by` gains a `ruling` parameter so the property is reachable from the tool people use. (The guard matched the two OBSERVATIONS that named this defect and the REQUIREMENT that answers it; this is the built thing that closes them.)

⭐⭐ THE FINDING THAT REFRAMED THE WORK, reproduced live BEFORE anything was designed: an Artifact carrying ANY `GOVERNED_BY` edge ALREADY escaped `orphan_node`, because the detector saw an EDGE and never a RULING. So silence was already available and was never the problem. WHAT WAS MISSING WAS THE COUNT — "deliberately parked" and "never looked at" gave the identical answer, a vacuous zero in different clothes, in the very increment named for instruments that overstate. A reader can now see "34 defects, 8 parked" instead of "97" or instead of nothing.

THE MEASURED FAILURE (dev_storyflow): defects 88 → 97 across ten artifact writes, EIGHT of them deliberate no-claim registrations a standing ruling prescribed, with 31 more owed in the same genre. Their framing is the requirement: the disposition rule and the defect detector make each other unreadable, and THE CORRECT ACTION DEGRADES THE INSTRUMENT — self-reinforcing, because a later seat watching the count climb has an incentive to stop registering documents, which is the worse state.

WHY THE EDGE (Anthony's call, 2026-08-17). On the NODE it needs declaring on every parkable type and a bare flag is an unevidenced claim. On the DECISION it parks everything that ruling governs, so a later GOVERNED_BY silently inherits parking. On the EDGE it is per-node and precise — one ruling parks the 31 documents it covers and nothing else — and TWO-SIDED BY CONSTRUCTION: the claim IS the edge to the ruling, so a deliberate state cannot be asserted without a Decision that says why.

⚠️ THE RULING MUST BE ACCEPTED. A `proposed` Decision is somebody thinking out loud — the discriminator `loop_status` already uses — so parking on an unsettled ruling would let a musing suppress a finding.

⚠️ AND A PROBE FAILED ON ITS FIRST RUN, WHICH FOUND THE REAL DEFECT. `parking_on_an_unsettled_ruling_does_not_count` proved the node was not COUNTED as parked, then failed on its second assertion: the finding did not come back either, because the `GOVERNED_BY` edge itself made the artifact "attached". So an UNSETTLED parking claim silenced a real defect. Fixed at the cause: a `ruling: parks` edge no longer counts as attachment — it is a claim that the node is deliberately attached to NOTHING, so counting it as attachment was self-defeating.

⭐ AND THE REACHABILITY TRAP WAS CAUGHT BY APPLYING THE SAME DAY'S LESSON. `governed_by` had no way to set `ruling`, so the property would have been reachable only through raw `create_edge` — the FOURTH instance of one pattern in a day, after `Verification.description` (declared, unreachable, 1 use in 164), `SUPERSEDES` (declared, 0 edges, successor named in prose 9 of 9), and `create_node` shipping a compare-and-swap whose precondition value it did not return. The parameter exists because the property would otherwise have gone unused.

📌 THE REPORTER'S OPEN BOUND IS CLOSED. They asked whether BL-176's DOCUMENTS/REALIZES guard was meant to cover this and misses it, or never contemplated it. NEVER CONTEMPLATED: BL-176 widened attachment for artifacts that DO carry a describing edge; this is an artifact that deliberately carries none.

⚠️ NOT DONE, and it is the music_graph half: F9 and F14 report that recording PLANNED work manufactures gaps (each planned capability immediately raises unrealized/unverified), so the gap list punishes writing a plan down. That is the same shape from a third direction and is NOT addressed here — parking is per-node and deliberate, whereas that case wants a whole class of tautological gap understood as planning rather than debt.
properties.name: A ruling can declare a state deliberate, and parked nodes are counted rather than silenced
